title: Fight Focus: boxing rounds
source: Owner's second cut (two InShot clips, 720p, bag work, uploaded 2026-10-30) with the round names typed on as reference labels. Rounds follow the owner's labels and order; the app's focus card covers the typed labels.

props.hook: The coach calls it. *You throw it.*

rounds.title: Lead hand strikes
rounds.cue: Lead hand only. Snap it back to your guard.

rounds.title: Rear hand strikes
rounds.cue: Turn the hip. Straight back to your guard.

rounds.title: Short speed combos
rounds.cue: Short and sharp. Reset, then fire again.

rounds.title: Nonstop striking
rounds.cue: Don't stop. Keep the hands moving.

rounds.title: Speed and power hooks
rounds.cue: Fast hooks, then sit down on them.

rounds.title: Nonstop windshield wipers
rounds.cue: Left, right, left, right. Don't stop.
